chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about salat (prayer) in the resting places of camels,
So he said: “If you fear loss regarding your belongings, then sweep it, sprinkle it with water, and perform salat (prayer). And there is no harm in performing salat (prayer) in the sheepfolds.”

key_terms.أَعْطَانِ الْإِبِلِ: the resting or watering places of camels
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual worship under discussion
key_terms.الضَّيْعَةَ: loss or wasting away, here referring to concern for one’s property
key_terms.مَرَابِضِ الْغَنَمِ: the resting places or pens of sheep

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) in camel resting places or sheepfolds?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about performing salat (prayer) in animal enclosures. It indicates that if a person fears for his belongings, he may prepare the camel resting place by cleaning and sprinkling it, then pray there, while prayer in sheepfolds is stated to be unobjectionable.
